name: edits-through-tools
description: Refuses every route that changes file content under the working tree without going through Write, Edit or NotebookEdit - sed -i and the other in-place editors, redirects, tee, cp/mv/install/rsync, patch and git apply, git used as an editor and the plumbing that skips the worktree, extraction and downloads into the tree, symlinks over tracked paths, shell indirection it follows into scripts and aliases, plus the server-side GitHub commit and the subagent grant that would sidestep all of it
